name: Test: Memory Stress
description: Quick-running pipeline for memory testing with loop nodes. Run this 5-10 times, switch between pipelines, drag nodes, undo/redo, then check JS heap via devtools: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize / 1024 / 1024

nodes.name: Generate Data
nodes.instructions: echo 'Generating test data...' && for i in $(seq 1 200); do echo "[batch $i] key=$(head -c 16 /dev/urandom | base64) value=$(head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64)"; done && echo 'Done.'

nodes.name: Process A
nodes.instructions: echo 'Processing branch A...' && for i in $(seq 1 100); do echo "[A-$i] processed"; done && echo 'Branch A complete.'

nodes.name: Process B
nodes.instructions: echo 'Processing branch B...' && for i in $(seq 1 100); do echo "[B-$i] processed"; done && echo 'Branch B complete.'

nodes.name: Merge Results
nodes.instructions: echo 'Merging loop results + A + B...' && sleep 1 && echo 'Merge complete. Loop items processed, plus 200 branch records.'

nodes.name: Final Report
nodes.instructions: echo '=== Memory Stress Test Report ===' && echo "Timestamp: $(date)" && echo "Hostname: $(hostname)" && echo 'Status: PASS' && echo '================================'
